config.customs.empty: No custom fields are defined yet. Add them on the Model screen
config.port.tooltip: Leave blank unless a non-standard port is used. This port is only used to build site URLs, e.g. http://www.example.com:8080/. It does not change the server port; set it to the port the server actually uses
config.contextPath.tooltip: Context path where the application is deployed on Tomcat or another application server. Leave blank if deployed under ROOT
config.channelUrl.tooltip: The default channel URL prefix is /channel. Leave blank to use the default, or change it to another path, e.g. /categories
config.articleUrl.tooltip: The default article URL prefix is /article. Leave blank to use the default, or change it to another path, e.g. /archives
config.multiDomain.tooltip: Enable this when multiple domains are used together with static page generation. The static page storage path will then include the domain name, keeping pages of different domains apart
config.console.sidebarTheme.tooltip: Sidebar style seen by new users and by users who have not chosen their own appearance. Users can pick their own under Appearance in the account menu
config.console.themeColor.tooltip: Theme colour seen by new users and by users who have not chosen their own appearance; the login page uses it too. Users can pick their own under Appearance
config.upload.imageTypes.tooltip: Image types allowed for upload. Separate multiple types with commas; leave blank for no restriction. Common formats: jpg,jpeg,png,gif
config.upload.videoTypes.tooltip: Video types allowed for upload. Separate multiple types with commas; leave blank for no restriction. Common formats: mp4,webm,ogg
config.upload.audioTypes.tooltip: Audio types allowed for upload. Separate multiple types with commas; leave blank for no restriction. Common formats: mp3,ogg,wav
config.upload.libraryTypes.tooltip: Library document types allowed for upload. Separate multiple types with commas; leave blank for no restriction. Common formats: pdf,doc,docx,xls,xlsx,ppt,pptx
config.upload.docTypes.tooltip: Document types allowed for DOC import. Separate multiple types with commas; leave blank for no restriction. Common formats: doc,docx,wps,xls,xlsx
config.upload.fileTypes.tooltip: File types allowed for upload. Separate multiple types with commas; leave blank for no restriction. Common formats: zip,7z,gz,bz2,iso,rar,txt,pdf,doc,docx,xls,xlsx,ppt,pptx
config.upload.imageMaxWidth.tooltip: Images uploaded through the editor that exceed this width are resized automatically. 0 means unlimited
config.upload.imageMaxHeight.tooltip: Images uploaded through the editor that exceed this height are resized automatically. 0 means unlimited
config.grey.greyDates.tooltip: Enter as MM-DD with single-digit months or days zero-padded; separate multiple dates with commas, e.g. 09-08,12-13
config.register.usernameRegex.tooltip: By default allows Chinese characters, letters, digits and . - _
config.security.passwordMinDays.tooltip: The password cannot be changed again until it has been in use for this many days. 0-998. 0 means no limit; 15 is typical
config.security.passwordMaxDays.tooltip: Once a password has been in use longer than this many days, it must be changed before logging in. 0-999. 0 means no limit; 90 is typical
config.security.passwordWarnDays.tooltip: When the password has fewer than this many days of validity left, a reminder is shown at login. 0-90. 0 means no warning; 7 is typical
config.security.passwordMaxHistory.toolt: Number of previous passwords that cannot be reused. 0-24. 0 means no limit; 5 is typical
config.security.userMaxAttempts.tooltip: The user is locked out after more failed login attempts than this. 0-100. 0 means no limit; 5 is typical
config.security.userLockMinutes.tooltip: How long a user stays locked out after exceeding the allowed login attempts. Unit: minutes. 1-1440; 30 is typical
config.security.ipCaptchaAttempts.toolti: A captcha is required once an IP address (IPv6: per /64 prefix) has more failed login attempts than this. 0-100. 0 means a captcha is always required; 3 is typical
config.security.ipMaxAttempts.tooltip: An IP address (IPv6: per /64 prefix) is blocked from logging in for 2 hours after more failed attempts than this. 0-999. 0 means no limit; 10 is typical
config.security.twoFactor.tooltip: When enabled, both the password and an SMS verification code are required to log in. The code is sent to the mobile number registered on the account; admin users without one cannot log in
config.security.twoFactor.requiresSms: No SMS service is configured. Configure it under "SMS Settings" first, then enable two-factor authentication.
config.security.twoFactor.requiresOwnMob: No mobile number is registered for your own account, so you could not log in afterwards. Register your mobile number in user management first.
config.security.twoFactor.requiresUserMa: Set "User max attempts" to a value greater than 0 first; otherwise SMS codes could be guessed without limit.
config.security.twoFactor.confirm:
Once enabled, logging in requires both the password and an SMS code sent to the registered mobile number.

Enable it?
config.security.twoFactor.confirmWithCou:
Once enabled, logging in requires both the password and an SMS code sent to the registered mobile number.
{count} admin user(s) have no mobile number registered and will not be able to log in; register their numbers in user management as soon as possible.

Enable it?
config.security.forceChangePasswordOnFir: Force password change on first login
When enabled, users created in the console, users whose password was reset by an administrator, and the seeded admin must change their password before they can log in. Off by default
config.security.ssrfWhiteList.tooltip: Domains that may be accessed when fetching remote images or collecting content. One domain per line; a top-level domain such as example.com is enough. Use * to allow all domains, in which case only internal networks are blocked
config.security.applyL3.confirmTitle: Apply MLPS Level 3 (MLPS-L3) recommended security policy
config.security.applyL3.confirmContent:
The following security settings will be set to the recommended values:
· Password strength: letters + digits + special characters
· Password min length: 8
· Password max age: 90 days
· Password expiry warning: 7 days
· Password history: 3
· User max attempts: 5
· User lockout duration: 30 minutes
· IP max attempts: 10
· IP captcha threshold: 3
· Force password change on first login: on
· Two-factor authentication: on (only if an SMS service is configured and your own account has a mobile number registered; otherwise skipped automatically so administrators are not locked out)

Continue?
config.security.applyL3.success: MLPS Level 3 recommended security policy applied (including two-factor authentication)
config.security.applyL3.twoFactorSkipped: Recommended policy applied; two-factor authentication was not enabled because no SMS service is configured. Configure SMS under "SMS Settings" first, then enable two-factor authentication so administrators are not locked out.

Recommended policy applied; two-factor authentication was not enabled because no mobile number is registered for your own account. Register it in user management first, then enable two-factor authentication, so you are not locked out.
config.security.applyL3.usersWithoutMobi: MLPS Level 3 recommended security policy applied (including two-factor authentication). {count} admin user(s) have no mobile number registered and will not be able to log in; register their numbers in user management as soon as possible.
config.oauth.note: Once a provider is enabled with its app credentials, its sign-in button appears on the login and registration pages; changes take effect on save. Callback URLs are generated from the default site's protocol and domain and must be registered on each provider's platform.
config.oauth.registerDisabled: Registration is disabled: first-time visitors signing in through a provider must register a username and will not be able to finish signing in.
config.oauth.weixin.callbackUrl.tooltip: Create a Website App (QR-code login) on the WeChat Open Platform and set its authorized callback domain to the domain of this URL
config.oauth.qq.callbackUrl.tooltip: Create a Website App on QQ Connect and register this URL as the app's callback address; it must match exactly
config.oauth.weibo.callbackUrl.tooltip: Create a website app on the Weibo Open Platform and register this URL as its authorization callback page; it must match exactly
config.sms.signName.tooltip: The SMS signature must be approved by the SMS provider first
config.email.host.tooltip: Fill in according to your email provider's help documentation and make sure SMTP is enabled. Usually in the form smtp.xxx.com
config.email.port.tooltip: Leave blank for the default port. Usually left blank, or filled in according to your email provider's help documentation
config.email.ssl.tooltip: Whether to use SSL. Some email providers require SSL, e.g. QQ Mail
config.email.timeout.tooltip: Leave blank for the default timeout. Unit: milliseconds. Usually left blank
config.email.username.tooltip: Usually the same as the sender address, or the part of the sender address before the {'@'}
config.email.password.tooltip: Some mail servers require a separate app password or authorization code; set it up in your mailbox management console
config.email.subject: Verification email subject
config.ai.enabled.tooltip: When disabled, all AI features are unavailable (including article translation and channel name translation via machine translation engines); the configuration is kept
config.ai.providers.tooltip: OpenAI-compatible protocol (POST {baseUrl}/chat/completions); supports DeepSeek, Qwen, Zhipu GLM, Moonshot, Ollama, vLLM and more. Up to 10 providers
config.ai.provider.name: Name
config.ai.provider.baseUrl.tooltip: Without the /chat/completions part, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1 or http://10.0.0.8:8000/v1
config.ai.provider.apiKey.tooltip: Not shown again after saving. Leave blank to keep the stored key; may be empty for on-premises deployments such as Ollama/vLLM
config.ai.provider.apiKey.optional: Optional; on-premises deployments such as Ollama/vLLM need no key
config.ai.provider.temperature.tooltip: 0-2. Leave blank to use the provider default
config.ai.provider.extraParams.tooltip: A JSON object merged as-is into every request body, for provider-specific parameters (protocol fields such as model and messages are never overridden). Most commonly used to turn off deep thinking on reasoning models: the thinking process consumes the generation budget, so short-output calls such as AI generation, AI titles and AI moderation return empty content with the error "AI service response could not be parsed". Use "Test" before saving to confirm the provider accepts the parameter
config.ai.provider.extraParams.suggest: This base URL belongs to "{0}", whose reasoning models enable deep thinking by default; short-output calls such as AI generation, AI titles, moderation and pre-translation may return empty content.
config.ai.defaultProvider.tooltip: Provider used by AI features by default
config.ai.writingProvider.tooltip: Provider used by the writing assistant; leave blank to use the default provider
config.ai.moderationProvider.tooltip: Provider used for content moderation; leave blank to use the default provider
config.ai.translationProvider.tooltip: Default provider for article pre-translation and bulk translation creation (articles and channels). Choose an LLM provider or a machine translation engine (Baidu Translate / Youdao Translate / DeepL); leave blank to use the default LLM provider. Any machine translation engine with credentials filled in below can still be picked per run when creating translations in bulk, whether or not it is selected here
config.ai.mt.baiduAppId.tooltip: Obtained after enabling the general text translation service on the Baidu Translate Open Platform (fanyi-api.baidu.com)
config.ai.mt.youdaoAppKey.tooltip: Obtained after creating a text translation app on Youdao Zhiyun (ai.youdao.com)
config.ai.mt.deeplAuthKey.tooltip: Keys ending in :fx automatically use the free API endpoint
config.ai.logRetentionDays.tooltip: Days to keep AI call logs; minimum 30. The Cybersecurity Law requires such logs to be retained for at least six months; default 180 days
config.ai.dailyTokenLimit.tooltip: Daily token limit (prompt + completion) across all sites; 0 means unlimited
config.ai.test.thinking.title: Connected, but the model has deep thinking enabled
config.ai.test.thinking: Model {0}, took {1}ms. The response contains deep thinking content: the thinking process consumes the generation budget, so short-output calls such as AI generation, AI titles, moderation and pre-translation may return empty content and fail.
config.ai.test.thinking.suggest: The base URL was recognized as "{0}". Apply its disable-deep-thinking preset and test again?
config.ai.test.thinking.pick: Edit this provider, choose the preset matching the vendor below "Extra request parameters", then test again.
config.ai.test.thinking.stillOn: This provider already has extra request parameters, but the model is still using deep thinking: check that the parameter names match the vendor (fields differ between vendors; see the presets).
config.ai.error.extraParamsObject: Must be a JSON object; click a preset below to fill it in
config.ai.siteNote: This page sets AI providers, credentials and global quotas; which AI features each site enables is set under "Site Settings → AI Features"
config.storage.type.10: Object storage (MinIO, Alibaba Cloud OSS, Tencent Cloud COS, Qiniu Kodo, AWS S3)
config.storage.port.tooltip: Default port is 21 (may be left blank); implicit TLS uses port 990
config.storage.passive.tooltip: Passive mode is used in most cases
config.error.channelUrlPattern: Must start with / and contain only letters, digits, hyphens and underscores
config.error.articleUrlPattern: Must start with / and contain only letters, digits, hyphens and underscores
config.error.storagePathAllowed: Paths starting with file: must be allowlisted via ujcms.storageFilePrefix in /WEB-INF/classes/application.yaml
site.permalink.article.id.description: Best performance; suited to sites with a very large amount of content
site.permalink.article.idSlug.descriptio: Default; suited to medium and large news portals
site.permalink.article.slug.description: Most readable; suited to small business sites and blogs
site.permalink.pinyin.tooltip: When on, a purely Chinese title gets a pinyin slug automatically; when off, the slug of a purely Chinese title falls back to the article ID
site.permalink.reindexTip: After switching the URL format, rebuild the full-text index (Generation → Article full-text index → Rebuild this site's index): the search index stores article URLs
site.permalink.htmlTip: When static pages are enabled, article URLs follow the static path settings instead
site.watermark.enabled.tooltip: When enabled, images uploaded through the editor or into article image sets are watermarked
site.watermark.minWidth.tooltip: Images narrower than this are not watermarked
site.watermark.minHeight.tooltip: Images shorter than this are not watermarked
site.html.enabled.tooltip: Turning static pages on starts generating them automatically; channel and article pages visited before generation finishes may return a 404 error, so wait for it to complete. Turning static pages off deletes the generated files, and visiting those static URLs afterwards returns a 404 error
site.html.auto.tooltip: When on, static pages are generated automatically whenever articles or channels are created, updated or deleted; when off, they must be generated manually
site.html.listPages.tooltip: With automatic generation on, generating only 1 list page is recommended; later pages are served dynamically instead
site.html.channel.tooltip: Available parameters: channel ID {'{channel_id}'}, channel slug {'{channel_slug}'}
site.html.article.tooltip: Available parameters: channel ID {'{channel_id}'}, channel slug {'{channel_slug}'}, article ID {'{article_id}'}, article slug {'{article_slug}'}, year {'{year}'}, month {'{month}'}, day {'{day}'}
site.html.generating: Saved. Static pages are being regenerated; see the task list in {menu} for progress
site.comment.loginRequired.tooltip: When off, anonymous comments are allowed
site.comment.auditRequired.tooltip: When off, comments are shown immediately without moderation
site.comment.imageEnabled.tooltip: When on, signed-in members can upload images in their comments
site.mailbox.handlingDays.tooltip: A letter must be answered within this period from the date it is accepted, counted in working days (only weekends are excluded; public holidays are not)
site.mailbox.extendedDays.tooltip: After an extension, the letter must be answered within this period; it should be longer than the handling period
site.mailbox.smsEnabled.tooltip: When on, an SMS notification is sent to the writer's mobile number when a letter is answered. An SMS provider must be configured in Global Settings first
site.mailbox.smsTemplateCode.tooltip: Request a notification-type template from your SMS provider. Use the template Code for Alibaba Cloud or the template ID for Tencent Cloud; the template parameter is the letter number. Tencent Cloud limits template variables to 12 characters by default while letter numbers are 19 digits, so ask for the limit to be raised to 32 characters
site.mailbox.smsCodeName.tooltip: Alibaba Cloud only: the name of the variable in the template, defaults to code. Tencent Cloud uses positional parameters, so leave this blank
site.accessibility.entryButton.tooltip: Show the floating "Accessibility" entry button on the left edge of the page; when off, the toolbar can still be opened from the header button or the Shift+X shortcut
site.accessibility.defaultOpen.tooltip: Expand the toolbar automatically on first visit; the visitor's choice is remembered after they close it
site.accessibility.helpUrl.tooltip: URL of the site's own accessibility statement / help page, opened by the toolbar's Help button; leave blank to use the built-in help dialog (shortcut table)
site.accessibility.elderUrl.tooltip: URL of the site's senior / care edition, opened by the toolbar's Care Mode button; leave blank to use the built-in care mode (page zoom, wider spacing, large cursor)
site.ai.seoAssist.tooltip: AI generates the SEO title, keywords, description, summary and tags on the article edit page
site.ai.writingAssist.tooltip: AI polishing, expanding, proofreading and continuation in the article editor
site.ai.screening.tooltip: Screens editor content for sensitive words, error-prone words and AI-detected semantic risks
site.ai.dailyTokenQuota.tooltip: Daily token quota (prompt + completion) for this site; 0 means no limit, still subject to the global daily cap
site.ai.moderationMode.tooltip: Comments and messages are classified asynchronously by AI after they are saved. Flag: labels only, for human reference; Auto-handle: acts only on pending content and never touches published content
site.ai.autoApproveBelow.tooltip: Content with risk confidence below this value is approved automatically; auto-handle mode only
site.ai.autoBlockAbove.tooltip: Content with risk confidence above this value is blocked automatically; auto-handle mode only, and it must be greater than the auto-approve threshold
site.ai.replyDraft.tooltip: AI drafts message board replies for staff to review and edit; nothing is sent automatically
site.ai.translate.tooltip: Pre-fills linked draft translations within the language group using AI; drafts only, they must be proofread before publishing
site.ai.relatedAssist.tooltip: "Suggest" on the article form lets AI pick among candidate articles and explain each; when off, candidates come from title similarity, shared tags and same channel only
site.ai.error.threshold: The auto-block threshold must be greater than the auto-approve threshold
site.ai.readiness.disabled: Global AI is off; none of the switches on this page take effect
site.ai.readiness.noDefaultProvider: No default provider is configured globally; AI features without a specific provider will not work
site.ai.readiness.providerMissing: No provider is configured globally for this feature; this switch has no effect
site.ai.readiness.translationMissing: No translation provider is configured globally or the engine credentials are incomplete; AI pre-translation will not work
site.geo.jsonLdEnabled.tooltip: Emit schema.org structured data (WebSite, BreadcrumbList, NewsArticle) on the default template's home, channel and article pages so search engines and AI answer engines can understand and cite the content; articles containing AI-generated content carry an AIGC property
site.geo.llmsTxtEnabled.tooltip: Serve /llms.txt at the site root (llmstxt.org convention) introducing site channels and latest articles to AI engines; returns 404 when disabled
site.geo.llmsTxtChannelIds.tooltip: Channels listed in llms.txt; defaults to top-2-level navigation channels when empty
site.geo.llmsTxtArticleCount.tooltip: Number of latest published articles listed in llms.txt (0-100); 0 omits the article list
site.geo.robotsEnabled.tooltip: Serve /robots.txt dynamically at the site root; returns 404 when disabled so a physical file or CDN rule can take over. The root site's robots.txt also announces the sitemaps of sub-directory sites on the same host
site.geo.robots.subDirNotice: This is a sub-directory site: crawlers only read robots.txt at the host root and never the one under a sub-directory. Maintain robots.txt in the root site's GEO settings; the root site announces this site's sitemap automatically
site.geo.disallowedAiAgents.tooltip: Deny list: checked crawlers receive a Disallow rule; unchecked crawlers are allowed (GEO welcomes AI crawlers by default). Grouped by purpose: blocking training crawlers normally does not affect being cited in AI search; custom content, when set, takes precedence
site.geo.disallowedAiAgents.training.tip: Collect content for model training and are the usual candidates for blocking; Google-Extended and Applebot-Extended are usage tokens and do not stop the Google or Apple search crawlers
site.geo.disallowedAiAgents.search.tip: Index content for AI search and cite sources in answers; GEO normally allows them
site.geo.disallowedAiAgents.user.tip: Fetch a page live when a user asks; most ignore robots.txt, so a checkmark is only a statement of intent
site.geo.disallowedAiAgents.other.tip: Legacy entries not in the current catalog (such as the retired Claude-Web); uncheck to remove
site.geo.disallowedAiAgents.overridden: Custom content is set; the checked entries have no effect
site.geo.robotsCustom.tooltip: When not blank, served verbatim and overrides the generated rules above; the Sitemap lines of this site and its sub-directory sites are appended only when the content has no Sitemap line of its own
site.geo.baiduPushEnabled.tooltip: Submit article URLs to Baidu Webmaster Tools (Common Inclusion → API Submission) automatically after publishing; each URL is submitted at most once per 24 hours, 2000 per request, against the site's daily quota; results are shown under Push Status below and written to the application log
site.geo.baiduPushUrl.tooltip: Paste the full endpoint URL shown on the Baidu Webmaster Tools Common Inclusion → API Submission page (includes the site and token parameters)
site.geo.baiduPushUrl.invalid: Must be an endpoint of the form http(s)://data.zz.baidu.com/urls?…
site.geo.indexNowEnabled.tooltip: Notify IndexNow (shared by Bing, Yandex, Naver, Seznam and others) automatically after an article is published, updated or permanently deleted; the key file is served by this site from the key below, nothing to upload; network failures are retried up to 3 times
site.geo.indexNowKey.tooltip: 8-128 letters, digits or hyphens; click Generate for a random key; after saving, engines verify the key file at the address below
site.geo.push.none: Not pushed yet (cleared on application restart)
site.geo.push.test.tooltip: Submit the site homepage now using the saved settings (Baidu counts it against the daily quota); unsaved changes are ignored
model.name: Name
model.field.name: Field name
model.field.clob.tooltip: Large fields are not shown in data lists, which improves performance somewhat. Changing this setting after data has been entered may cause data loss. Regular fields are stored in the database column `mains_json_`, large fields in `clobs_json_`
model.field.policy.tooltip: HTML is filtered with the selected policy on submit to prevent cross-site scripting. Rich text (most permissive, for trusted console editors), Basic (basic formatting, links and images only), Strict (basic formatting and nofollow links only, for public-facing fields). Defaults to Rich text when blank.
model.field.fileAccept.tooltip: Allowed file types; must be within the range allowed by global settings, and the global setting is used when blank. Same format as the HTML input accept attribute, e.g. .doc,.docx,image/png,image/jpeg
model.field.fileMaxSize.tooltip: Maximum file size; must be within the limit allowed by global settings, and the global setting is used when blank. Unit: MB
model.field.error.invalidCode: Only letters and digits are allowed
model.empty: No models of this type yet
model.readonly: Read-only: editing a global model requires global data permission
model.singletonTip: This type has one built-in model that is used everywhere by a fixed id; no more can be added
model.scope.tooltip: Private to this site: only this site can use it. Shared globally: every site can use it, field changes affect all of them, and global data permission is required
model.scope.lockedTip: Other sites use this model, so it cannot be made private to this site
model.error.nameExist: A model of this type already has this name
model.confirmDiscard: You have unsaved changes. Close anyway?
model.field.error.codeKeyConflict: Conflicts with the option key of field {code}
model.field.codeChangedTip: Changing a saved field's code hides the values already entered under it; templates that read the field must be updated too
model.field.confirmDelete: This field is saved. Deleting it hides the values already entered under it. Delete anyway?
model.field.dictType.globalOnly: A global model can only bind globally shared dictionary types
model.designer.empty: Click or drag a field type on the left to add custom fields
model.designer.invalid: {count} field(s) failed validation; fix them before saving
dictType.name: Name
dictType.dataType.tooltip: Data type of the dictionary values; string is fine unless you have a specific need. Cannot be changed after creation
dictType.title: Dictionary type
dictType.readonly: Read-only: modifying a global dictionary requires the global data permission
dictType.confirmDelete: This also deletes the {count} entries of this type. Delete it?
dictType.usages.deleteTip: In use by model fields; cannot be deleted
dictType.scope.lockedTip: Models of other sites or global models use this dictionary; it cannot be made private to this site
dict.label: Dictionary
dict.name: Name
dict.sys.tooltip: System dictionaries are written by the installation skeleton: the alias and sharing scope of system types, and the value and enabled state of system entries, are locked and cannot be deleted; regular entries under a system type can be maintained freely
dict.empty: This type has no entries yet
performanceType.name: Name
performanceType.score.tooltip: Score earned for each article published
